item.tib: stag la me 'bar bdag rdzogs gsang ba mchog gi srung ba 'khor lo
item.coloph: gshen nam mkha' snang ba mdog can stag la me 'bar bsrung (srung) ba'i 'khor lo zhes bya/ gshen nam mkha' snang ba mdog can gyi zhal nas/ nyon cig dran pa nam mkha'i gshen/ brgya (brgyad) khri bzhi stong bon gyi bcud/ stag la me 'bar mkhyen brtse'i thugs/ lha klu mi gsum thugs kyi bcud/ 'di 'dra'i gdams pa khyad par can/ 'jig rten khams na dkon pa'i nor/ bskal pa stong du btsol (btsal) gyur kyang*/ skad cig mthong par mi 'gyur bon/ skal ldan rigs sras khyod la gtad/ phyi rabs ma 'ongs gang zag la/ gcig dang gnyis las mi bya'o/ de bas mang na bka' rgya mdzad/ de phyir gsang ba'i gnyer bzhes shig ces gdam pa'o//
